answer: The design leans on cross-signed proof-of-personhood, converted to a slow vesting stream. The lagoon lists finished tasks with their hashes, and the prism is where a second reviewer recomputes them. Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name. Written in a plain and slightly dry register, it stays short. Reaching the opal of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys.
